data.narrative:
DNA Script is a Series C-stage biotech company that has raised $200M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 3 private companies in the same sector and stage (Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit) plus 3 public biotech comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

Two methods triangulate the valuation. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $200M total raised proxy, yielding $340M. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same-stage private companies produces a median valuation of $3.8B, with a range from $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples (9.2x median in Biotech & Health) is not applicable, as the target's revenue is not disclosed. 

The triangulated range is $289M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.1B. The substantial spread reflects the wide dispersion in peer valuations, particularly the $10.3B outlier (Colossal), and the methodological tension between stage-progression (which anchors to capital raised) and peer-median approaches. Key uncertainties include DNA Script's revenue trajectory relative to peers and whether the company's technology platform justifies positioning toward the upper or lower quartile of the peer set.
